newsitem.title: UK: Luminar sets rights issue to raise 15.6 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Luminar sets rights issue to raise 15.6 mln stg.

text.p: Luminar Plc, owner and operator of bars, restaurants and discos, on Tuesday set a one-for-three rights issue at 320p per share on Tuesday to raise 15.6 million stg.
The company said in a statement the proceeds would be used to expand its Chicago Rock Cafe bar and restaurant business. Luminar has 17 Chicago Rock Cafe's and plans to open another nine in 1997.
Luminar also said it expects to report pre-tax profits for the year ended February 23 1997 of not less than 3.68 million stg and earnings per share of no less than 17.7p per share.
The company plans to recommend a final dividend for the year ended February 1997 of 4.67p per share, to give a total 7p.
